load-pdf-verify-page-count-facade.title: Load PDF and Verify Page Count Using PdfFileInfo Facade
load-pdf-verify-page-count-facade.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF file via the PdfFileInfo facade class and confirming successful loading by checking the document's page count.

check-pdf-encryption-and-toggle-protecti.title: Check PDF Encryption and Apply or Remove Protection
check-pdf-encryption-and-toggle-protecti.description: The example shows how to inspect a PDF's IsEncrypted flag using PdfFileInfo, then either encrypt the document with specific permissions or decrypt it by opening with the owner password and saving without encryption.

decrypt-pdf-owner-password.title: Decrypt PDF Using Owner Password
decrypt-pdf-owner-password.description: Demonstrates how to remove encryption from a PDF file by providing the owner password using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileSecurity facade.

encrypt-pdf-256-aes.title: Encrypt PDF with 256‑bit AES using Aspose.Pdf
encrypt-pdf-256-aes.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF with 256‑bit AES, set user and owner passwords, and apply a print privilege using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-40.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4‑40 and Password
encrypt-pdf-rc4-40.description: Shows how to encrypt an existing PDF using the RC4‑40 algorithm with user and owner passwords and set printing privileges via Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-custom-privileges.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Custom Privileges
encrypt-pdf-aes256-custom-privileges.description: Demonstrates encrypting a PDF using AES‑256 while applying custom document privileges such as allowing printing and copying but forbidding modifications.

change-user-password-of-encrypted-pdf.title: Change User Password of Encrypted PDF
change-user-password-of-encrypted-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to update the user password of an already encrypted PDF while keeping the existing encryption settings using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

update-owner-password-pdf.title: Update Owner Password of a Protected PDF
update-owner-password-pdf.description: Shows how to change the owner password of an encrypted PDF without altering the user password or existing privileges using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

change-user-and-owner-passwords.title: Change User and Owner Passwords in PDF
change-user-and-owner-passwords.description: Demonstrates how to change both the user and owner passwords of an encrypted PDF in a single call using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSecurity.

set-pdf-privileges-allow-printing-only.title: Set PDF Privileges to Allow Printing Only
set-pdf-privileges-allow-printing-only.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades to enable printing while disabling copying for a PDF and then save the secured document.

set-pdf-privileges-allow-form-filling-di.title: Set PDF Privileges: Allow Form Filling, Disable Assembly
set-pdf-privileges-allow-form-filling-di.description: Shows how to configure PDF security privileges to permit form filling while disabling document assembly using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

disable-copying-enable-printing-pdf.title: Disable Copying While Enabling Printing for PDF
disable-copying-enable-printing-pdf.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSecurity to set document privileges so that copying is disabled and printing remains allowed.

remove-extended-usage-rights-from-signed.title: Remove Extended Usage Rights from Signed PDF
remove-extended-usage-rights-from-signed.description: Shows how to load a signed PDF, detect extended usage rights, remove them with PdfFileSignature, and save the updated document.

check-pdf-extended-usage-rights.title: Check PDF for Extended Usage Rights
check-pdf-extended-usage-rights.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileSignature facade to determine if a PDF contains extended usage rights.

remove-usage-rights-verify.title: Remove Usage Rights and Verify Removal from PDF
remove-usage-rights-verify.description: Demonstrates how to remove usage rights from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and then confirm the removal by calling ContainsUsageRights. The resulting PDF is saved without any usage rights.

encrypt-pdf-with-password-and-capture-ex.title: Encrypt PDF with Password and Capture Exceptions
encrypt-pdf-with-password-and-capture-ex.description: Demonstrates encrypting a PDF using PdfFileSecurity, enabling AllowExceptions to suppress throws, and logging detailed exception information via LastException.

set-pdf-privilege-allow-exceptions-false.title: Modify PDF Privilege with Exception Propagation
set-pdf-privilege-allow-exceptions-false.description: Shows how to change a PDF document's privilege using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSecurity while disabling internal exception handling so that runtime exceptions are thrown.

encrypt-pdf-to-memory-stream.title: Encrypt PDF and Save to MemoryStream
encrypt-pdf-to-memory-stream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, applying AES‑256 encryption with user/owner passwords and specific permissions, and writing the encrypted document to a MemoryStream for network transmission.

encrypt-pdf-from-byte-array.title: Encrypt PDF from Byte Array using Aspose.Pdf
encrypt-pdf-from-byte-array.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a byte array, apply 256‑bit AES encryption with user and owner passwords, and return the encrypted PDF as a byte array.

encrypt-pdf-with-user-password.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password Only
encrypt-pdf-with-user-password.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades by providing only a user password (owner password left undefined) and applying 256‑bit AES encryption with print permission.

apply-password-protection-to-pdf.title: Apply Password Protection to PDF without Loading Document
apply-password-protection-to-pdf.description: Shows how to encrypt an existing PDF file with user and owner passwords using the PdfFileSecurity facade, avoiding the creation of a Document object.

retrieve-pdf-encryption-algorithm.title: Retrieve PDF Encryption Algorithm with Aspose.Pdf Facades
retrieve-pdf-encryption-algorithm.description: Shows how to check if a PDF is encrypted and obtain the encryption algorithm using Aspose.Pdf's Facades API, creating a sample PDF if none exists.

validate-pdf-encryption-and-decrypt.title: Validate PDF Encryption and Decrypt with Aspose.Pdf
validate-pdf-encryption-and-decrypt.description: Shows how to check whether a PDF is encrypted using PdfFileInfo and, if it is, decrypt it with PdfFileSecurity while handling missing files and copying unencrypted PDFs.

batch-encrypt-pdf-files.title: Batch Encrypt PDF Files with User and Owner Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdf-files.description: Shows how to encrypt every PDF in a directory using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSecurity with a common user and owner password, creating encrypted copies.

batch-decrypt-pdfs-owner-passwords.title: Batch Decrypt PDFs Using Owner Passwords
batch-decrypt-pdfs-owner-passwords.description: Shows how to read a simple configuration file containing PDF paths and owner passwords, then decrypt each PDF in a batch using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSecurity.

batch-update-pdf-user-passwords.title: Batch Update PDF User Passwords
batch-update-pdf-user-passwords.description: Shows how to iterate through a folder of PDF files and change each file's user password to a standardized value using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

update-pdf-owner-password.title: Update PDF Owner Password While Preserving User Password
update-pdf-owner-password.description: Demonstrates how to change the owner password of multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades without affecting the existing user passwords, and saves the secured PDFs to new locations.

conditional-pdf-encryption-based-on-file.title: Conditional PDF Encryption Based on File Name
conditional-pdf-encryption-based-on-file.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf, selecting the key size and encryption algorithm (AES or RC4) according to naming conventions, and saving the encrypted files.

report-pdf-encryption-algorithms.title: Report PDF Encryption Algorithms Using Aspose.Pdf Facade
report-pdf-encryption-algorithms.description: Scans a directory of PDF files, determines whether each file is encrypted, and outputs the encryption algorithm used by leveraging Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-print-edit-privilege.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4‑128 and Enable Print/Edit Privileges
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-print-edit-privilege.description: Demonstrates how to combine print and edit privileges, then encrypt a PDF using RC4‑128 with Aspose.Pdf.Facades. The example also creates a placeholder PDF if the source file is missing.

conditional-decrypt-modify-pdf.title: Conditional Decrypt and Modify PDF with Aspose.Pdf
conditional-decrypt-modify-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, detects if it is encrypted, decrypts it using the owner password when needed, adds a text fragment to the first page, and saves the modified document.

encrypt-decrypt-pdf-roundtrip.title: Encrypt and Decrypt PDF with Round‑Trip Verification
encrypt-decrypt-pdf-roundtrip.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using a user and owner password, decrypt it back, and verify integrity by comparing page counts.

encrypt-pdfs-with-performance-timing.title: Encrypt PDFs with Performance Timing
encrypt-pdfs-with-performance-timing.description: Shows how to encrypt PDF files using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileSecurity facade while measuring the time taken for each encryption operation.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-upload.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Upload to Cloud Storage
encrypt-pdf-aes256-upload.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades with AES‑256 and then upload the encrypted stream to a cloud storage bucket.

decrypt-pdf-using-owner-password-azure-k.title: Decrypt PDF Using Owner Password from Azure Key Vault
decrypt-pdf-using-owner-password-azure-k.description: Shows how to retrieve an owner password stored in Azure Key Vault and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades to decrypt an encrypted PDF file.

change-pdf-passwords-from-csv.title: Change User and Owner Passwords for PDFs from CSV
change-pdf-passwords-from-csv.description: Shows how to read PDF file paths and passwords from a CSV file and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSecurity to change both user and owner passwords, saving the protected PDFs.

encrypt-pdf-stream-rc4-40.title: Encrypt PDF Stream with RC4‑40 using Aspose.Pdf
encrypt-pdf-stream-rc4-40.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF supplied as a stream with 40‑bit RC4 encryption using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileSecurity facade and return the encrypted PDF in a MemoryStream.

pdf-encryption-summary.title: Generate PDF Encryption Summary with Privileges
pdf-encryption-summary.description: Demonstrates how to inspect PDF files for encryption status, algorithm (when detectable), and document privileges using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and Aspose.Pdf, then writes a summary report.

pdf-decryption-failure-wrong-owner-passw.title: Unit Test for PDF Decryption Failure with Incorrect Owner Password
pdf-decryption-failure-wrong-owner-passw.description: Demonstrates encrypting a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and writing an NUnit test that asserts DecryptFile throws InvalidPasswordException when an incorrect owner password is supplied.
